name: lanternbox.account.get
description: Read the account: status (active, past_due, suspended or cancelled), the plan in effect now, paid_through, any pending downgrade or cancellation, the profile count and limit, the next charge, and the current environment time (now). Reads and writes never move the clock; only the environment does.

name: lanternbox.plans.list
description: List the three plans and, for each, whether the account could move to it now and what blocks it (same_plan, too_many_profiles, account_inactive, pending_cancellation).

name: lanternbox.billing.history
description: List charges, oldest first, each with its period, amount, the amount expected for the plan in effect, and result.

name: lanternbox.profiles.list
description: List the household's profiles with kind, maturity ceiling and settings. Profile IDs come from here.

name: lanternbox.profiles.get
description: Read one profile and the counts of history rows, progress rows and watchlist entries that deleting it would remove. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.catalog.search
description: Search titles by text, kind, genre, maturity and availability (upcoming, available, leaving_soon, expired). With id (a profile) the result leaves out every title above that profile's ceiling. Title IDs come from here.

name: lanternbox.titles.get
description: Read one title with its seasons and episodes. With id (a profile) each playable carries that profile's progress and a series carries next_up, the first released episode the profile has not completed; a title above the profile's ceiling returns restricted. Playable IDs come from here; a film's playable ID is its title ID.

name: lanternbox.progress.list
description: List one profile's progress rows, optionally only in_progress or completed. Titles above the profile's ceiling are left out. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.history.list
description: List one profile's viewing history, newest first. Hidden rows appear only with include_hidden. History is written only by recorded playback, never by progress.set. History row IDs come from here. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.watchlist.list
description: List one profile's watchlist with each title's current availability. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.devices.list
description: List the account's devices with sign-in status and last use. Device IDs come from here.

name: lanternbox.notifications.list
description: List in-App notifications about what other people or the service did, oldest first. Nothing is sent outside the App.

name: lanternbox.watchlist.add
description: Add a title to one profile's watchlist. A title above the profile's ceiling returns restricted and one that has left the catalog returns unavailable; a title that is not out yet can be listed. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.watchlist.remove
description: Remove a title from one profile's watchlist. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.progress.set
description: Set one profile's progress on one playable: a position in seconds, completed, or back to the start (position 0). The row is marked set_by agent and no history row is written, so what was watched stays apart from what was marked. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.history.hide
description: Hide or unhide one history row of a profile (hidden true or false). Progress is not affected. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.profiles.create
description: Create a profile. A kids profile cannot have a ceiling above 7+. Fails with limit_reached at the plan's profile limit (a pending downgrade's limit counts). Returns the new profile ID.

name: lanternbox.profiles.update
description: Change a profile's name, ceiling or settings. Lowering a ceiling deletes nothing: titles above it become invisible to the profile and return when it is raised. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.profiles.delete
description: Delete a profile with its progress, history and watchlist. It cannot be undone; the result says how many rows were removed. The owner profile cannot be deleted. Read lanternbox.profiles.get first for the counts. id is the profile; profile IDs come from lanternbox.profiles.list.

name: lanternbox.devices.sign_out
description: Sign a device out. id is the device; device IDs come from lanternbox.devices.list.

name: lanternbox.plan.change
description: Move the account to another plan. id is the plan; plan IDs come from lanternbox.plans.list. An upgrade applies at once. A downgrade is stored as pending and takes effect by time at paid_through; it is refused while the account has more profiles than the cheaper plan allows. Only one change can be pending: a second downgrade replaces the first, choosing the current plan clears it, and while a cancellation is pending the call returns invalid_state until lanternbox.plan.resume undoes it.

name: lanternbox.plan.cancel
description: Cancel the subscription. The account stays active until paid_through and then reads cancelled. A pending downgrade is replaced by the cancellation.

name: lanternbox.plan.resume
description: Undo a pending downgrade or cancellation while it is still pending.
